digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Record (ADR 0098) — Operation-Scoped Config and Provider Composition
propositions: ADR 0098 must document the approved architecture: immutable non-secret operation configuration composed separately from provider-auth/runtime bindings at application boundaries.
The ADR must cite primary-source research for all external dependency and OSS behavior claims covering Pydantic, OpenAI, Anthropic, boto3, credential helpers, and Rebar's current probes.
ADR 0098 narrows ADR 0049 only at per-job retrieval/composition and explicitly preserves its unaffected decisions regarding Ed25519/DSSE protocol, trust roots, producer, and SSM-at-rest storage.

The ADR records approved decisions on operation snapshot precedence, CLI/MCP/Python/service composition ownership, provider-native pre-client auth injection, static carrier use, subprocess environment rules, restart/redeploy rotation, fail-closed auth, and op-cert startup composition with exactly one key source.
